arms.measure: rx(sign * THETA / N), measure into mcm, repeated N times; measure into final
arms.delay: rx(sign * THETA / N), delay of one measure duration, repeated N times; measure into final
arms.unitary: rx(sign * THETA / 16), barrier, repeated 16 times; measure into final
arms.settle: rx(sign * THETA / 16), measure into mcm, delay of 2 us, repeated 16 times; measure into final
arms.t1: x, delay of 0, 20, 50, 100 or 200 us, delay of 2 us, measure into final
arms.ro0: delay of 2 us, measure into final

configuration.placement_contract: one single-qubit placement per qubit the layout rule keeps; every qubit runs each member in the same shots; every member ends in a reset, so every PUB is dynamic
